summary: Read a linked list whose nodes store integers. Decide whether following successor pointers can bring you back to a node you have already visited. Write true when that return happens, which means a cycle is present. Write false when the walk reaches an empty link instead. During the check, keep only a fixed count of pointers and do not allocate storage that grows with the number of nodes. An empty list writes false.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a node count followed by the integer stored in each node.
